description: Immutable snapshot of the unsaved-draft state in TmNotionPageCommentPanel (new comment, thread reply, inline reply, entry edit). Consumers build a dirty-guard from it (confirmation before a navigation discards an in-progress comment). Carries state flags only — never the draft text itself; the text reaches the comment provider on submit. HasUnsavedContent aggregates the slots; the inline reply's auto-inserted quote and an edit without changes are not user content and do not raise it.
